sources.title: WWF HydroSHEDS Basins Level 12 — Earth Engine Data Catalog
facts: Asset is a polygon FeatureCollection, not an image.
SUB_AREA and UP_AREA describe basin areas; no runoff depth, runoff coefficient, CN or drainage-density field is listed.
ORDER uses classical downstream hierarchy, not Strahler headwater numbering.
Underlying delineation is based on 15 arc-second data; polygon support is not a 90 m runoff grid.

sources.title: HydroBASINS — provider product description
facts: Product contains nested sub-basin boundary polygons and limited geometric/topological attributes.
HydroBASINS derives from 15 arc-second HydroSHEDS layers.

scope: Provider metadata check only; no source registration, dataset ingestion, replacement selection or scientific approval.
